{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Mar Balayan was believed killed nearly five years ago, prior to the debacle at Hoth, as all signs of him and his activities abruptly vanished after he was reported fighting a group of Stalimur pirates.|[[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]], ''[[Wanted by Cracken]]''|<ref name="Journal10">{{JournalCite|10|Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)}}</ref>}}
The '''Stalimur pirates''' was the collective name for several groups of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]<ref name="Journal10" /> from the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Stalimur]]. For eons, they operated in the [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belts]] of the [[Stalimur system/Legends|Stalimur system]].<ref name="Xim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref>
